The Munich School of Politics and Public Policy (HfP) combines excellence in political science with a commitment to dialogue between politics, society, business, and technology. The Professorship of Global Security and Technology focuses on contentious politics, political mobilization, and political violence, with a particular emphasis on the role of information and communication technologies. - Supervising Bachelor’s and Master’s theses
- Conducting quantitative analyses using primary and secondary data
- Preparing and co-authoring scientific publications as well as grant proposals
- Contributing to the administrative tasks of the professorship

- Ph.D. (or close to completion) in political science, economics, sociology, or a related social science discipline

- Excellent programming skills in R (or a comparable language)
